faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Project Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Fellow position ranges from 58,000 to 1,10,000 per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Project Fellow post is a PhD.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: You can apply by sending your detailed CV and relevant documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Fellow position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the interview date for the Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Project Fellow position is scheduled for 10 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Roorkee offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q9. What kind of experience is preferred for the Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: Experience including research, industrial field, and other relevant areas is preferred for the Project Fellow role.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.
